rubrics.justification: The response substantially misgrades the embryo versus the provided laboratory grade of 3AA, downgrading ICM and TE and adding speculative features like debris/granularity not reliably supported here.

It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, BMI, sperm motility, prior cycle history, and endometrial thickness, though some links (e.g., vegan diet) are speculative.
The structure is logical, but the prognosis is built on an incorrect morphology assessment and includes somewhat arbitrary percentage adjustments and speculative modifiers.

SET recommendation and general prognosis are guideline-consistent, but suggestions such as ERA, endometrial scratch, aspirin, sildenafil, and routine PGT-A in this context are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, though several recommendations are more optional or controversial than standard.
